image_description: A top-down view of a meat cleaver resting on a light-colored wooden cutting board. The cleaver has a large, rectangular steel blade with visible wear and some text etched onto the surface. The handle is textured, possibly wood or composite, attached to the tang with visible rivets. Above the cleaver are thin strips of what appears to be dried meat or leather, and a piece of paper with printed text is partially visible at the top edge.

The etching/text on the blade itself is slightly indistinct and lacks the sharp crispness of real laser etching or stamping, appearing somewhat 'painted on'.

The connection between the handle and the metal tang is slightly ambiguous; the rivets seem to float slightly above the surface without clear indentation or shadowing, suggesting minor geometric inconsistency.
